messages:
Renee Cole: Quick thread for a customer spotlight tied to next week's benchmark post. Need copy, signed quote, short clip, and lead routing.
Diego Morales: I'll validate numbers from infra today. ETA 2pm.
Priya Nair: I can write the one-pager and social copy. Do we want a stat in the tweet or only in the long form?
Renee Cole: Keep social qualitative. Put the ~38% cost reduction and latency improvements in the case study body.
LegalBot: Reminder: consent text required. Use the template and capture signer name/title/date.
Priya Nair: Draft social: "Redwood made our inference predictable and affordable 5a true enabler for our product". Open to edits.
Diego Morales: Numbers uploaded: cost per 1M tokens down ~38%, P95 latency improved by 45ms. Links in /files/benchmarks/spotlight.
Renee Cole: For routing, map demo interest to sales queue SALES-44 and "Dedicated interest" to AE-DED. ContentBot: can you create the checklist?
ContentBot: Checklist created: 1) Copy draft, 2) Signed consent, 3) Edited clip (15s), 4) One-pager PDF, 5) Webinar slide note.
Priya Nair: I'll schedule the recording for Thu 10am and include a 10s b-roll ask.
LegalBot: Once signed, email legal@redwood.ai and include signer name/title/timestamp in the message.
Renee Cole: Great. Please drop the signed PDF here when you have it. We'll aim to publish Thu 2pm PT. React with :white_check_mark: when done.
